observations: A white industrial-style sewing machine mounted on a white metal table with a foot pedal.
The machine has a visible red and white label on the front, but the text is too small to read clearly.
The table surface shows some stains and wear, especially near the needle area.
The metal legs and frame of the table show chipped paint and rust, particularly on the lower parts and foot pedal.
The foot pedal is heavily worn and covered in white dust or residue.
A black power cord is coiled and hanging from the machine.
Clothes are scattered on the floor in front of the table.
The background is a beige curtain and a gray wall.

claims.claim: In good condition and is working perfectly
claims.evidence: No photo shows the machine in operation or any close-up of internal components. The visible wear and rust on the table and pedal suggest age and use, but not necessarily malfunction.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal wear or damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle, bobbin area, motor, and belt system.

risks.risk: The table and frame may be structurally unstable due to rust and chipped paint.
risks.proof: A close-up of the metal joints and legs to check for corrosion or cracks.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the machine running with the pedal engaged.
Close-up photos of the needle, bobbin, motor, and belt system.
Close-up of the metal frame and joints to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an industrial sewing machine with table, but the seller's claim of working condition cannot be verified from the photo alone. Visible wear and rust suggest age and use, but internal functionality and structural integrity are unknown. Proof of operation and close-ups of key components are needed before pricing.
